transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here today. As we discussed, the middle school is planning to launch a student peer-mediation program for the spring semester, and the current draft proposes twelve student mediators, mediation sessions on Mondays and Wednesdays during lunch, one adult supervisor, and referrals for minor and moderate student conflicts. Before I can give final approval for the program's operating plan, we need to go through the student-services approval checklist. I'd like each of you to report on your assigned checklist item in one uninterrupted round, and I'll record your reports and any required plan changes before making my final approval decision. Let's go ahead and get started.

transcript.text: I need to report on the roster and training status as the peer-mediation advisor. My classroom observation and training log show that M4 and M9 have not completed the required mediation practicum, while M1, M2, M3, M5, M6, M7, M8, M10, M11, and M12 have completed it. I recorded this in my advisor notes this week but have not yet entered it into the program roster.

transcript.text: I need to report on the referral-screening requirements as the counselor. My current student-services file review identifies active no-contact orders involving students Nia and Omar. Referrals involving either of these students must be screened out of peer mediation. I confirmed the no-contact orders with the families this week, but I have not yet added the screening requirement to the draft operating plan.

transcript.text: I need to report on the safety and supervision requirements as the school psychologist. My safety review, which I finalized yesterday, finds that student mediators may handle only minor peer conflicts and may not handle threats or moderate conflicts. Additionally, the approved operating protocol must assign two adult supervisors to every mediation session. I have not yet attached this review to the launch proposal, but these are the required safety and supervision changes that need to be reflected in the operating plan before approval.
